budget.calculation: 91 contexts * 4 selected guided + 4 selected anchor; repeated candidate selections deduplicated within each context

comparison.selection: four lowest predicted costs among gate-passing, unrevealed indices 4..N-1; stable source-order ties
comparison.utility: maximum -fitness over four pre-revealed indices and four selected indices

max_conditional_base_kl.definition: max per-context KL(softmax(-guided_cost/0.4208) || softmax(-anchor_cost/0.4208)) on gate-passing unrevealed candidates

limitations: The 91-context DL-Val roster is the candidate development contract and has prior checkpoint-selection exposure.
This single reused development-cohort diagnostic cannot establish independent generalization or close RNK-10 M5/S4/S2/Q1 or production qualification.
The scorer loads each pinned DL-Val pool file; only the pre-revealed inputs and selected top-four guided/anchor utilities contribute to the registered gate metrics.
source_run_manifest: absent for round 882; full-run operations provenance retained in source_commit_basis
